Only extract and group phrases that already exist in the feedback.

{

      "count": 0
    }
  ]
}

- Merge similar phrases ONLY when they have the same meaning (even across languages — e.g. "Good teacher" and "Maayong maestra" and "Maayong guro" can be grouped)
- Keep the most common or clearest version as the representative phrase
- Do NOT create new words or invent phrases

- Do NOT add explanations

Bisaya: "Maayong maestra" / "Klaro ang leksyon" / "Ba

parameters.text:
=You are an expert educational consultant. Review the following student feedback for an instructor.
Based on the feedback, provide a comprehensive evaluation structured into four distinct parts.

CRITICAL RULES:
1. You must output strictly in RAW JSON format. 
2. DO NOT wrap the output in markdown blocks like 
```json. Output ONLY the JSON object starting with { and ending with }.
3. ALL values must be single STRINGS. DO NOT use arrays [ ] for the positives or improvements.

Match this exact schema: 
{
  "interpretation": "A supportive summary of what the students are collectively saying.",
  "positives": "A single string paragraph summarizing the key positive themes.",
  "improvements": "A single string paragraph summarizing the areas flagged for improvement.",
  "suggestion": "A single, constructive, and actionable paragraph of final advice."
}

Student Feedback:
{{ $json.formatted_remarks }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO management_results (
  instructor_id, term_id, subject_id, total_responses,
  m1_total, m2_total, m3_total, m4_total, m5_total,
  m6_total, m7_total, m8_total, m9_total, m10_total, grand_total,
  m1_mean, m2_mean, m3_mean, m4_mean, m5_mean,
  m6_mean, m7_mean, m8_mean, m9_mean, m10_mean,
  overall_management_mean, average_per_response_management
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::numeric,
  $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7::numeric, $8::numeric, $9::numeric,
  $10::numeric, $11::numeric, $12::numeric, $13::numeric, $14::numeric, $15::numeric,
  $16::numeric, $17::numeric, $18::numeric, $19::numeric, $20::numeric,
  $21::numeric, $22::numeric, $23::numeric, $24::numeric, $25::numeric,
  $26::numeric, $27::numeric
)
ON CONFLICT (instructor_id, term_id, subject_id) DO UPDATE SET
  total_responses = EXCLUDED.total_responses,
  m1_total = EXCLUDED.m1_total, m2_total = EXCLUDED.m2_total,
  m3_total = EXCLUDED.m3_total, m4_total = EXCLUDED.m4_total,
  m5_total = EXCLUDED.m5_total, m6_total = EXCLUDED.m6_total,
  m7_total = EXCLUDED.m7_total, m8_total = EXCLUDED.m8_total,
  m9_total = EXCLUDED.m9_total, m10_total = EXCLUDED.m10_total,
  grand_total = EXCLUDED.grand_total,
  m1_mean = EXCLUDED.m1_mean, m2_mean = EXCLUDED.m2_mean,
  m3_mean = EXCLUDED.m3_mean, m4_mean = EXCLUDED.m4_mean,
  m5_mean = EXCLUDED.m5_mean, m6_mean = EXCLUDED.m6_mean,
  m7_mean = EXCLUDED.m7_mean, m8_mean = EXCLUDED.m8_mean,
  m9_mean = EXCLUDED.m9_mean, m10_mean = EXCLUDED.m10_mean,
  overall_management_mean = EXCLUDED.overall_management_mean,
  average_per_response_management = EXCLUDED.average_per_response_management

INSERT INTO performance_results (
  instructor_id, term_id, subject_id, total_responses,
  p1_total, p2_total, p3_total, p4_total, p5_total,
  p6_total, p7_total, p8_total, p9_total, p10_total, grand_total,
  p1_mean, p2_mean, p3_mean, p4_mean, p5_mean,
  p6_mean, p7_mean, p8_mean, p9_mean, p10_mean,
  overall_performance_mean, average_per_response_performance
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::numeric,
  $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7::numeric, $8::numeric, $9::numeric,
  $10::numeric, $11::numeric, $12::numeric, $13::numeric, $14::numeric, $15::numeric,
  $16::numeric, $17::numeric, $18::numeric, $19::numeric, $20::numeric,
  $21::numeric, $22::numeric, $23::numeric, $24::numeric, $25::numeric,
  $26::numeric, $27::numeric
)
ON CONFLICT (instructor_id, term_id, subject_id) DO UPDATE SET
  total_responses = EXCLUDED.total_responses,
  p1_total = EXCLUDED.p1_total, p2_total = EXCLUDED.p2_total,
  p3_total = EXCLUDED.p3_total, p4_total = EXCLUDED.p4_total,
  p5_total = EXCLUDED.p5_total, p6_total = EXCLUDED.p6_total,
  p7_total = EXCLUDED.p7_total, p8_total = EXCLUDED.p8_total,
  p9_total = EXCLUDED.p9_total, p10_total = EXCLUDED.p10_total,
  grand_total = EXCLUDED.grand_total,
  p1_mean = EXCLUDED.p1_mean, p2_mean = EXCLUDED.p2_mean,
  p3_mean = EXCLUDED.p3_mean, p4_mean = EXCLUDED.p4_mean,
  p5_mean = EXCLUDED.p5_mean, p6_mean = EXCLUDED.p6_mean,
  p7_mean = EXCLUDED.p7_mean, p8_mean = EXCLUDED.p8_mean,
  p9_mean = EXCLUDED.p9_mean, p10_mean = EXCLUDED.p10_mean,
  overall_performance_mean = EXCLUDED.overall_performance_mean,
  average_per_response_performance = EXCLUDED.average_per_response_performance

WITH mgmt_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(total_responses), 0) AS m_total_resp,
    COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) AS m_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(grand_total)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(total_responses) * 10, 0), 0) AS m_avg
  FROM public.management_results
  WHERE instructor_id = $1::uuid AND term_id = $2::uuid
),
perf_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(total_responses), 0) AS p_total_resp,
    COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) AS p_total,
    COALESCE(SUM(grand_total)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(total_responses) * 10, 0), 0) AS p_avg
  FROM public.performance_results
  WHERE instructor_id = $1::uuid AND term_id = $2::uuid
)
INSERT INTO public.overall_total_survey (
  instructor_id, term_id, total_responses, management_total, performance_total, combined_total, management_mean, performance_mean, combined_score_mean
)
SELECT 
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, 
  m.m_total_resp, -- (Note: using Management total as the baseline, or you can use GREATEST(m.m_total_resp, p.p_total_resp))
  m.m_total, p.p_total, 
  (m.m_total + p.p_total), 
  m.m_avg, 
  p.p_avg, -- Now this correctly uses p.p_total_resp!
  (m.m_total + p.p_total)::numeric / NULLIF((m.m_total_resp * 10) + (p.p_total_resp * 10), 0)
FROM mgmt_stats m, perf_stats p
ON CONFLICT (instructor_id, term_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  total_responses = EXCLUDED.total_responses,
  management_total = EXCLUDED.management_total,
  performance_total = EXCLUDED.performance_total,
  combined_total = EXCLUDED.combined_total,
  management_mean = EXCLUDED.management_mean,
  performance_mean = EXCLUDED.performance_mean,
  combined_score_mean = EXCLUDED.combined_score_mean;

SELECT 
  id AS instructor_id, 
  first_name, 
  last_name,
  $2 AS subject_search_term
FROM public.user_info 
ORDER BY similarity(COALESCE(first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(last_name, ''), $1) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.instructor_wordcloud (instructor_id, term_id, word, count)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::int)
ON CONFLICT (instructor_id, term_id, word) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  count = instructor_wordcloud.count + EXCLUDED.count,
  updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO public.instructor_ai_suggestions (
  instructor_id, 
  term_id, 
  ai_suggestion, 
  student_interpretation, 
  positive_themes, 
  improvement_insights
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, 
  $2::uuid, 
  $3::text, 
  $4::text, 
  $5::text, 
  $6::text
)
ON CONFLICT (instructor_id, term_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
  ai_suggestion = EXCLUDED.ai_suggestion,
  student_interpretation = EXCLUDED.student_interpretation,
  positive_themes = EXCLUDED.positive_themes,
  improvement_insights = EXCLUDED.improvement_insights,
  updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO public.overall_question_means (instructor_id, term_id, category, question_number, mean_score)
WITH m_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_responses) as tr, 
        SUM(m1_total) as m1, SUM(m2_total) as m2, SUM(m3_total) as m3, SUM(m4_total) as m4, SUM(m5_total) as m5, 
        SUM(m6_total) as m6, SUM(m7_total) as m7, SUM(m8_total) as m8, SUM(m9_total) as m9, SUM(m10_total) as m10
    FROM public.management_results 
    WHERE instructor_id = $1::uuid AND term_id = $2::uuid
),
p_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_responses) as tr, 
        SUM(p1_total) as p1, SUM(p2_total) as p2, SUM(p3_total) as p3, SUM(p4_total) as p4, SUM(p5_total) as p5,

    FROM public.performance_results 
    WHERE instructor_id = $1::uuid AND term_id = $2::uuid
)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'Management', 1, COALESCE(ROUND((m1/NULLIF(tr,0))::numeric, 2), 0) FROM m_totals UNION ALL

SELECT 
  s.id AS subject_id, 
  s.subject_code, 
  s.subject_name,
  s.department_id,
  $1 AS instructor_id
FROM public.subjects s
JOIN public.instructor_subjects ins 
  ON ins.subject_id = s.id
  AND ins.instructor_id = $1
  AND ins.term_id = (
    SELECT current_term_id 
    FROM public.system_settings 
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY similarity(
  COALESCE(s.subject_code, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(s.subject_name, ''), 
  $2
) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.user_info
    WHERE $1 ILIKE '%' || first_name || '%' 
      AND $1 ILIKE '%' || last_name || '%'
    LIMIT 1
) AS "instructor_ID";

INSERT INTO public.subjects (subject_code, subject_name, department_id)
VALUES (
    $1, 
    $2, 
    (SELECT id FROM public.department_name WHERE d_name = $3 LIMIT 1)
)
ON CONFLICT (subject_code) 
DO UPDATE SET 
    subject_name = EXCLUDED.subject_name,
    department_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.department_id, subjects.department_id)
RETURNING id AS subject_id, department_id;
